finalText:
**The build passes now.** Two real bugs hid in the warning wall, not one.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | `retries` renamed to `retryCount` | Read both keys |
| [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | Unset flag now `undefined`, threw | Unset means off |

The other 8 warnings are just deprecation noise. They name files like `src/legacy/adapter.js` that do not exist here.

Next: nothing. Build exits 0.
